WITH gender_invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(i.invoice_number) as invoice_count
  FROM Invoices i
  INNER JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
shares_with_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    invoice_count,
    invoice_count * 1.0 / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () as share,
    AVG(invoice_count * 1.0 / SUM(invoice_count) OVER ()) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM gender_invoice_counts
)
SELECT 
  gender,
  invoice_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as share_minus_avg
FROM shares_with_avg
WHERE share > avg_share
